name: open-side-protocol
description: Hardware-agnostic, zero-dependency decentralized P2P standby compute grid (Single Compute Sea protocol) pooling idle hardware for distributed task execution.

scripts.check: node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); function check(dir) { for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) { const p = path.join(dir, f.name); if (f.isDirectory()) check(p); else if (f.name.endsWith('.js')) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', p]); } } check('src'); console.log('Syntax check passed across all src modules.');"
scripts.verify:deps: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); if (Object.keys(pkg.dependencies || {}).length || Object.keys(pkg.devDependencies || {}).length) process.exit(1); console.log('Zero dependencies verified.');"
